Cost: 10 Cycles

The Mirai botnet: default-password cameras and routers conscripted by the thousand. Each pwned device donates Cycles.
Cost: 10 Cycles

tools.name: Poisoned Package
tools.tooltip:
Poisoned Package
A typosquatted npm package quietly pulled into a thousand CI builds. A supply-chain compromise — big Cycles.
Cost: 40 Cycles, 10 Intel, 40 Cash

tools.name: Cloud Cryptojacker
tools.tooltip:
Cloud Cryptojacker
Stolen cloud keys spin up racks of instances on someone else's bill. Heavy Cycles.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 10 Intel, 60 Cash

tools.name: Phishing Kit
tools.tooltip:
Phishing Kit
An Emotet-style mail lure sprayed across an office. Sweeps Intel from inboxes in range.
Cost: 12 Cycles

tools.name: Scraper Botnet
tools.tooltip:
Scraper Botnet
Credential-stuffing bots grinding leaked dumps against logins across the feeds. Sweeps Intel in range.
Cost: 15 Cycles

tools.name: Magecart Skimmer
tools.tooltip:
Magecart Skimmer
A few lines of JavaScript on a checkout page. Skims card data — pays out in Crypto.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 20 Intel, 30 Cash

tools.name: Darknet Market
tools.tooltip:
Darknet Market
A Silk Road stall. Sells your stolen Intel for Cash.
Cost: 25 Cycles

tools.name: Exploit Forge
tools.tooltip:
Exploit Forge
A zero-day lab. Refines Intel (burning Cycles) into Tools — the exploits you need to breach ICE.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 10 Intel, 30 Cash

tools.name: Crypto Mixer
tools.tooltip:
Crypto Mixer
A tumbler that launders stolen Crypto into clean, spendable Cash.
Cost: 25 Cycles, 5 Intel, 50 Cash

tools.name: Research Lab
tools.tooltip:
Research Lab
A reverse-engineering rig. Grinds Intel (burning Cycles) into Research — the know-how to unlock new facilities.
Cost: 25 Cycles, 10 Intel

tools.name: Proxy
tools.tooltip:
Proxy
Turn ANY producer into a pure data proxy: it stops producing but forwards packets toward C2 at MINIMUM upkeep, sees far (scout/repeater), and merges many thin links into one fat trunk. Build proxies to push your reach toward new districts cheaply.
Cost: 15 Cycles

tools.name: DNS Tunnel
tools.tooltip:
DNS Tunnel
iodine-style: data smuggled inside DNS queries. Small, cheap, silent.
Cost: 5 Cycles

tools.name: VPN Tunnel
tools.tooltip:
VPN Tunnel
WireGuard: an encrypted link. Medium throughput, and it actively COOLS your Trace.
Cost: 20 Cycles, 10 Cash

tools.name: Reverse Shell
tools.tooltip:
Reverse Shell
A fat pipe straight back to C2. Fast — and LOUD (raises Trace).
Cost: 20 Cycles, 10 Cash

tools.name: HTTP/2 Flood
tools.tooltip:
HTTP/2 Flood
A multiplexed firehose. Huge throughput, pricey, moderately loud.
Cost: 35 Cycles, 25 Cash

tools.name: Onion Route
tools.tooltip:
Onion Route
Bounces through many hops — reaches far-off districts, costs a Tool.
Cost: 25 Cycles, 15 Cash, 1 Tools
